knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A pump that is not running can still be connected to power, so isolation is confirmed before any work.
A damaged cord is replaced immediately, and an extension lead is not used. The replacement is referred to a licensed electrician.
A humming motor can indicate a jammed impeller. The supply is turned off and the fault is referred to the maintenance company or a licensed person.
The protective devices and bonding section says the manufacturer asks for a residual current device at the supply point.

practicalCriteria: Isolator is identified and the supply confirmed off before any inspection, with lock-out or tag where the site requires
Cord, plug and socket are inspected and any damage is referred with the time recorded
An extension cord or buried cord is recognised and refused or referred
The worker states which electrical tasks are licensed and refers them without attempting them
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Isolation record for one supervised visit
Referral note to a licensed electrician where applicable
stopWorkCriteria: Pump worked on while running or connected
Motor opened or rewired by an unlicensed person
Extension cord used as a supply for the pump
